rows.ARS:
Medium yellow Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: TANilyks
Exhibition name: Skyline ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Hans Jürgen Evers (1940-2007) (Germany, 1991).
Introduced in Germany by Rosen-Tantau/Tantau Roses in 1991 as 'Skyline'.
rows.Bloom: Yellow. [Light yellow.]. Moderate fragrance. up to 30 petals. Average diameter 4". Medium to large, very double, cupped-to-flat, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Long, pointed buds.
rows.Habit:
Upright, well-branched. Large foliage.

Height: 5' to 6' (150 to 185cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Disease susceptibility: susceptible to Mildew. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
